projects.title: Tuberculosis Visualization
projects.description: Interactive visualization of tuberculosis prevalence data across different regions and time periods
projects.summary: An interactive Tableau dashboard visualizing tuberculosis prevalence data globally, enabling public health insights through geographic and temporal analysis.
projects.challenge: Presenting complex epidemiological data in an accessible format that allows both researchers and the public to understand tuberculosis trends.

projects.title: Construction Document RAG Pipeline
projects.description: Flask-based RAG demo that retrieves context from sample construction reference docs and generates grounded answers with LangChain and OpenAI.
projects.summary: A retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that answers construction-domain questions using chunked markdown documents, OpenAI embeddings, and a Flask web interface. Originally prototyped against building code PDFs; the public version uses original sample reference material to avoid redistributing copyrighted publications.
projects.challenge: Demonstrating a realistic RAG architecture without publishing proprietary building code documents, while keeping the demo useful enough to show retrieval quality and source citation behavior.
projects.solution: Reframed the project as an architecture demo with original sample markdown in foundations, framing, and electrical/safety topics. Kept doc_parser.py as an optional local tool for developers to convert their own licensed PDFs, with gitignored directories for private ingestion.
results: End-to-end RAG flow: chunk → embed → retrieve → generate
Header-aware markdown splitting with source metadata
Deployable Flask app with gunicorn support
